title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-04-06
source: SBD : FM > MR > C1 > DAT > CD

ai_review.summary: Clear FM broadcast with good sound quality captures a damn‑good show, though there are a few rough spots.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the performance as solid and enjoyable, noting that this version includes historic radio announcements and removes dead‑air tuning sections. The recording is described as clear and the best of the available copies, making it an easy listen despite occasional minor imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong, mostly positive reviews (4‑ and 5‑star) highlight a good musical performance and clear recording; limited sample size keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FM radio source with historic announcements, dead‑air removed; clear and consistent sound, considered the best of the existing copies.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers simply note an overall solid performance.
